name: Volumetric Supervision for NeRF
definition: A hybrid reconstruction method that improves the quality of the canonical volume in dynamic tomography by combining projection-based training with volumetric supervision from high-fidelity static X-CT data at key time steps (t=0 and t=1).
summary: Volumetric Supervision for NeRF improves dynamic tomography fidelity by combining projection training with volumetric loss from high-fidelity X-CT data, unlike standard NeRF which relies solely on 2D consistency.
